status: Schematic refinement for evaluation; not implemented manufacturing CAD
supersedes: Button-only return as the preferred A1 study direction
user_constraints: Add a small rubber band to return the plunger
Join two twine lengths with an inline rubber band along the grabber neck to accommodate excess pull
Provide a 3D review model instead of only PNG sketches

parts: open tray body with integral pulley axle
removable keeper cover with axle-tip support socket
proposed_architecture.return: One small loop around broad rounded fixed crossbar and moving yoke, with symmetric legs and retaining lips; behind central cord path
proposed_architecture.guidance: Two separated short bearing regions, relieved between them; front/back retention by tray and cover
proposed_architecture.stops: Broad bilateral press shoulders and a return stop; return gap must be set against real button geometry
proposed_architecture.assembly: Load plunger and pulley into open tray, route band and cord, then screw on cover. Fastener locations unresolved.
proposed_architecture.mount_interface_target: Retain V3 8.8 mm holes at local Y +/-9.5, Z -14; do not assume cover fasteners can share these holes before packaging check
proposed_architecture.printing: Tray back on bed with pockets and axle up; plunger broad face down; pulley axis vertical with chamfered groove; cover exterior down and inside details up
